title: Happy path: {{cast.plain}} signs in to {{vocab.org}} with pi.flow
takeaway: Four calls and no browser redirect: open the flow, post the password, resume, exchange the code. The tokens carry acr, amr, auth_time, sub and the nonce.

title: {{cast.plain}} mistypes the password once, then succeeds
takeaway: A wrong password does not kill the flow. It stays at USERNAME_PASSWORD_REQUIRED with an error and an attempt counter.

title: {{cast.plain}}'s {{vocab.org}} sign-in locks after three wrong passwords
takeaway: After the limit even the right password is refused until the lock lapses.

title: Resume with a stale session-token cookie is rejected
takeaway: The cookie changes on every step. Replaying an older one at /resume is refused; the current one still works.

title: A flow left open too long expires
takeaway: Flows live five minutes in this mock. After that the credentials step is refused and the client must start over.

title: An authorization code is used twice
takeaway: The code is single use. The second exchange is invalid_grant.

title: The token request carries the wrong PKCE verifier
takeaway: The code is bound to the S256 challenge from step 1. A different verifier is refused and the code is burned.

title: A redirect-based login attempt is refused
takeaway: This lab signs in with pi.flow only. Without response_mode=pi.flow the authorize request is an error and no flow or cookie is issued.

title: {{cast.plain}} signs in with a password, then the {{vocab.action}} asks for more
takeaway: The resource answers 401 with an RFC 9470 challenge naming a mock acr. The client re-authorizes with acr_values, the engine forces MFA, and the retry succeeds. The acr names are mock.

title: {{cast.strong}}'s authentication is too old for the {{vocab.action}}
takeaway: The token is fine and strong enough, but auth_time is older than the resource allows. The challenge carries max_age; a fresh sign-in fixes it.

title: CIBA: {{cast.plain}} approves on the mock phone
takeaway: The client starts a backchannel request, polls (authorization_pending), the mock phone approves, the next poll returns tokens.

title: CIBA: {{cast.plain}} denies on the mock phone
takeaway: A denial ends the request: the next poll is access_denied.

title: CIBA: nobody answers in time
takeaway: Past expires_in the poll returns expired_token.

title: CIBA: the client polls too fast
takeaway: Polling inside the interval returns slow_down and the interval grows by five seconds.

title: CIBA: the binding message is too long
takeaway: The mock limits binding_message to 8 characters and refuses a longer one with invalid_binding_message. The limit is a mock value, not verified against a real tenant.

title: {{cast.multi}} signs in with a password and a one-time passcode
takeaway: Two enrolled devices means DEVICE_SELECTION_REQUIRED, then OTP_REQUIRED, then RESUME_REQUIRED. The token's acr is mock:multi and amr lists the factors.
